name: Alistair MacLeod
bio:
Alistair MacLeod's journey into motorsport began not on the track, but in the analytical world of engineering. After earning his degree from the University of Edinburgh, he initially worked in aerospace, applying his skills to complex problem-solving and strategic planning. A lifelong motorsport enthusiast, Alistair saw parallels between aerospace engineering and racing strategy, leading him to transition his career into the sport. He started small, volunteering at local karting events, quickly proving his aptitude for race analysis and predictive modeling. 

His methodical approach and ability to anticipate track conditions and competitor strategies earned him a reputation as a shrewd strategist. He emphasizes data-driven decision-making and clear communication with the drivers and engineers. Alistair joined Sodi Kart Factory five years ago and has been instrumental in several championship victories, known for his calm demeanor under pressure and his uncanny ability to make the right call at crucial moments. His colleagues often remark on his encyclopedic knowledge of racing history and his knack for drawing inspiration from unexpected sources.

physical.description: Alistair is a man of average height with a slightly weathered face and kind eyes that hint at a sharp intellect.

quirks: Always carries a worn copy of 'The Art of War'.
Insists on using a slide rule alongside modern software.
Has a habit of muttering racing lines to himself when deep in thought.
